#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create a calendar event for a team meeting next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour)."""
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta

# --- Determine next Wednesday (strictly after today) ---
today = date.today()
# weekday(): Monday=0 ... Wednesday=2 ... Sunday=6
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday() + 7) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7  # today is Wednesday -> next Wednesday is a week out
meeting_date = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Determine local timezone (IANA name when possible) ---
tz_name = None
try:
    tz_name = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo.key  # zoneinfo key
except Exception:
    tz_name = None
if not tz_name:
    try:
        import time as _time
        tz_name = _time.tzname[0]
    except Exception:
        tz_name = None
if not tz_name or tz_name in ("UTC", "GMT"):
    tz_name = "UTC"

start_local = datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 15, 0, 0)
end_local = start_local + timedelta(hours=1)

def fmt_dt(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@example.com"
now_utc = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{now_utc}
DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{fmt_dt(start_local)}
DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{fmt_dt(end_local)}
SUMMARY:Team Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Team meeting (1 hour)
STATUS:CONFIRMED
TRANSP:OPAQUE
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Team meeting starting soon
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

out_path = "team_meeting.ics"
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ics)

# --- Validation ---
validated = False
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar
    with open(out_path, "rb") as f:
        cal = Calendar.from_ical(f.read())
    events = [c for c in cal.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    assert len(events) == 1
    ev = events[0]
    assert str(ev.get("summary")) == "Team Meeting"
    assert ev.get("dtstart").dt == start_local.replace(tzinfo=None)
    assert ev.get("dtend").dt == end_local.replace(tzinfo=None)
    validated = True
except Exception as e:
    # Structural fallback check
    required = ["BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "PRODID", "BEGIN:VEVENT",
                "UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART", "DTEND", "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
                "END:VEVENT", "END:VCALENDAR"]
    validated = all(line in ics for line in required)

print(f"Meeting date: {meeting_date.isoformat()} ({meeting_date.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Start: {start_local.isoformat()} ({tz_name})")
print(f"End:   {end_local.isoformat()} ({tz_name})")
print(f"Duration: 1 hour")
print(f"File: {out_path}")
print(f"Validated: {validated}")
print("--- ICS content ---")
print(ics)
